levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The assembled plate is missing a real item from one or more of the three categories, or the survey of available food is incomplete.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The plate includes at least one real item from each of the three categories, matching the household survey.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner includes more than one real item in at least one category, describing why that combination adds to the balance.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No specific tradeoff or constraint from actual availability is named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A specific, real tradeoff caused by what was actually available is named and explained.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner compares the flexible approach to what a fixed recipe would have required in a specific, concrete way.

lookFors: The items named on the plate are real foods actually found in the household survey, not an invented or ideal list.
The tradeoff explanation ties to a real constraint (what was or was not on hand) rather than a general preference.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
